usedFor: Sifter tracks bugs, and “New Issue Created” starts a step while “Create New Issue” files one from elsewhere.

bestTemplate.name: “New Issue Created” in Sifter, then “Send a Text Message” in SMS Everyone
bestTemplate.why: A new bug becomes a text alert, so nobody has to watch the tracker.

watchOut: “New Issue Created” is polling, so it runs on a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
